title: Mac Shell 8-Destination Navigation
statement: Shell navigates across Settings, Servers, Activity, Skills, Discover, Evals, Cleanup, Inbox via sidebar and Cmd+1..8 keyboard shortcuts.

title: Servers Board Live Inspection & Placards
statement: Servers board reflects live server states (running, tripped, never used, held change) from ServerStateTracker without polling duplicates.

title: Stale Readout Withholds Live Figures
statement: When tracker enters stale state, readout numbers go absent rather than displaying last-known counts as current.

title: Remote Device Queues, Never Installs
statement: Phone actions only enqueue items to Mac Inbox; no path from phone or notifications can trigger server install without explicit human review on Mac.

title: Menu Bar Popover & Attention Rows
statement: Menu bar popover renders attention rows, readout, and inbox band with oldest-first arrivals and no review affordance for partial items.

title: Immediate Banner Withdrawal on Disposition
statement: Disposing an inbox item immediately withdraws its notification banner and updates the popover band before the next poll.

title: Multi-item Notification Banner Carries Review Only
statement: When multiple items arrive, notification category presents Review only and suppresses Decline button.

title: Phone Triage, Queue, and Library
statement: Phone UI allows triaging discovered capabilities, queueing selections with single-batch undo, and browsing local library.

title: Router Core Stdio & HTTP Upstream Pool
statement: RouterCore manages live child stdio processes and HTTP connections with lifecycle cleanup and SIGTERM/SIGKILL reaping.

title: Loopback Control API & Auth Routes
statement: Control API provides authenticated endpoints on 127.0.0.1 for server management, config mutation, and OAuth callback listening on 8880.

title: Atomic Config Mutations with Staging Locks
statement: Mutations to servers.json use atomic staging files and directory locks to prevent concurrent write clobbering.

title: Wire Parity with TypeScript Router Reference
statement: Swift RouterCore reproduces JSON serialization, error structures, manifest digests, and CLI behaviors against TypeScript reference across 83 manifest rows.
